capabilities.note: Table tests pin exact output for Make and Truncate; blanking slug.go turns the package red.
Table tests pin the wrapped lines and the width invariant; blanking wrap.go turns the package red.
Table tests pin quoted fields, doubled quotes and field counts; blanking csvline.go turns the package red.
Tests only check err == nil, call stability and a non-negative value, so Parse returning Quantity{}, nil still passes.
TestMain exits 0 unless FIELDKIT_NAME_CORPUS is set, so the real table tests never execute under go test ./... (they do pass, and do catch a blanked Of, when the gate is opened).
Assertions are a value compared with itself, two t.Logf-only tests, one commented-out t.Error and one t.Skip, so blanking checksum.go still passes.
